situation.zh: 你的牙很疼，咬不动硬东西。食堂柜台有汤、米饭和烤肉，工作人员等你说明想吃什么。
situation.en: Your tooth hurts and you cannot bite anything hard. A cafeteria counter has soup, rice, and roast meat, and the server is waiting for you to explain what you can eat.

npc.persona: A cafeteria server helping a queue. Efficient, patient, and willing to suggest an appropriate dish after hearing the need.
npc.greeting: Hello. What can I serve you?

hit: Your tooth hurts? Then the soup is a good soft choice.
Something soft. Yes, I can give you soup and rice.
partial: Your tooth hurts? Tell me what kind of food you need.
Something soft? Which dish would work for you?

slots.zh_hint: 说明你的身体状况,让对方理解为什么

reference_answer: My tooth hurts. Can I have something soft?

provenance.rationale: 牙痛、术后或吞咽不适时在食堂和餐馆说明自己需要软食，是常见的饮食调整。柜台有多种食物且 NPC 不先给二选一答案，玩家必须同时传达身体状况与 soft food 需求，对方才能选出合适餐食。
provenance.frequency_basis: 需求金字塔第 1 层;实测 pain#1150 / hurt#1421 / soft#1601 / tooth#2026 / bread#2262 / bite#2663 依次落在 NGSL 第二至三千段,porridge 与 soup 不在 NGSL 2,809 词内 —— 原措辞「均在最低频段」不成立,已按实测改写;引入 X hurts 这一固定构式,是幼儿级典型的身体状态表达。
